params.message:
The projection read by id serves published posts only

GET /internal/projection/articles/:id returned any piece by its id, drafts
included, to whoever held PROJECTION_TOKEN. It now answers what the manifest
lists, a published post, and 404 for anything else, which the site already
reads as gone. A draft reaches the site only through a preview link.

This also closes a gap in the site's reconcile: it upserts what comes back for
an id the manifest listed a moment earlier, so a post unpublished in between
was written back as a public copy.
